goal: Test whether some historical 5/6 events can be rescued by a strictly causal boundary-ranking mechanism without using target outcomes.

scope.boundaryCase: missing winner rank near the frozen ticket cutoff
scope.deepCase: missing winner rank materially outside the frozen cutoff

frozenRankerArtifact.frozenConfigs: all 12 configurations frozen by v141; no configuration may be added, removed or retuned after this contract

frozenTicketCutoff.rulePolicy: exactly these three pre-existing v141 boundary substitutions; no new rescue rule may be introduced after freeze

discoveryWindow.note: 2018-05-25 through 2026-08-14 was previously exposed by v138/v141 and is therefore discovery evidence for v314, not a clean v314 holdout

holdoutWindow.note: Only draws whose predictions/rankings are frozen before the official draw may enter v314 validation

matchedCostNullSpec.conditioning: same eligible baseline 5/6 event and same frozen 8-number pool
matchedCostNullSpec.operation: one add/drop substitution per tested rescue, preserving pool size 8 and 14 EUR theoretical ticket cost
matchedCostNullSpec.addCandidate: uniform without replacement from numbers 1..49 not in the frozen pool
matchedCostNullSpec.dropCandidate: uniform from the eight numbers in the frozen pool

freeze.multiplicityMethod: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise error control at alpha=0.05 over 12 frozen ranker configurations x 3 frozen boundary rules
freeze.successMetric: primary: rescued5to6 rate among prospectively eligible baseline 5/6 events; success requires positive uplift over the matched-cost null with Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and no post-freeze retuning

secondaryMetrics: 4/6, 5/6 and 6/6 counts before and after rescue
temporal stability by prospectively completed blocks
inference.promotionPolicy: No predictive claim and no real-money promotion before minimumEligibleEvents is reached and the primary successMetric survives multiplicity correction.

successGate: Must improve reproducibly on frozen baselines in prospective holdout and survive matched-cost null plus multiplicity correction.
failureGate: Archive as negative if rescue appears only in historical discovery, fails the prospective matched-cost null, or requires post-hoc threshold/rule changes.
scientificNote: The previously exposed 2018-2026 interval is explicitly not reused as a fresh v314 holdout. v314 validation starts prospectively after this contract freeze.
